description.en: DSH's officially top-recommended TUI plugin — high performance, low overhead, cute pixel whale, smooth mouse interaction. One-command install via npm. / DSH 官方首推的 TUI 插件，高性能低占用，可爱像素鲸鱼，流畅鼠标交互，npm 一键安装
description.zh: Claude Code 风格全屏终端 UI：像素鲸鱼顶栏、实时工作状态行、思考流式展开。

description.en: 开放的侧边栏底座，支持三方拓展注册新侧边栏页面。内置文件渲染编辑/终端/侧边对话/Git/子代理页面 ｜ Open sidebar foundation, supports third-party extensions to register new sidebar pages. Built-in file rendering/editing, terminal, side chat, Git, and sub-agent pages.
description.zh: 侧边栏完整工作台：内置文件渲染编辑、终端、Git 与子代理，支持三方插件注册新 Tab。

description.en: The first vision plugin for DeepSeek Harness, and the vision bridge for every text-only coding agent. Paste an image, get structured JSON evidence (OCR, layout, semantics). | 全网最强 DeepSeek Harness 外挂视觉插件，为 DeepSeek、GLM 等纯文本模型外挂视觉能力，粘贴图片即得结构化 JSON 证据（OCR、版面、语义）。
description.zh: 为纯文本模型架起视觉桥梁：粘贴图片，输出结构化 JSON 证据（OCR、版面、语义）。

description.en: Answer me with HTML — an agent skill that answers hard questions with a one-page HTML you can actually read. 让 AI Agent 用一页 HTML 回答复杂问题。
description.zh: 把回答做成一页可视化 HTML：模型只写简短的 Markdown 草稿，随包附带的 `am` 命令行生成页面，支持流程图、时序图、树、时间线、ER 图、表格和提示框。

description.en: A toolkit for low-level operations in DSH, designed to reduce token usage and task execution time / DSH 底层操作工具插件，旨在减少 Token 消耗与任务耗时
description.zh: 为 Windows 的 DSH 提供 bash、PowerShell 7 及 Rust 高性能工具，减少 token 消耗。

description.en: Swaps the filesystem and bash providers for a mirage virtual workspace: file tools and shell commands run over mounted resources (RAM, S3, Redis, Slack, Gmail, Notion, Postgres) instead of the host disk, with per-mount read/write/exec modes, per-command sandbox routing (monty, pyodide, quickjs in process; docker, e2b, daytona remote), and installed CLIs (git, gh, slack, linear, ntn, gws, or one you register) as head words in the virtual terminal.
description.zh: 把文件系统与 bash provider 替换为 mirage 虚拟工作区：文件工具与 shell 命令运行在挂载资源上（RAM、S3、Redis、Slack、Gmail、Notion、Postgres），支持按挂载读/写/执行模式、按命令的沙箱路由（monty、pyodide、quickjs 进程内；docker、e2b、daytona 远程），并可在虚拟终端把已安装 CLI（git、gh、slack、linear、ntn、gws 或自注册）作为起始词使用。

description.en: A memory management kit that helps agents remember, refine, and recall user information across sessions for personalized interactions.
description.zh: 为智能体提供跨会话记忆管理，帮助记住、优化并回忆用户信息，实现个性化交互。

description.en: Connects DeepSeek Harness to ReMe's local-first, self-evolving personal knowledge base: automatically captures completed main-agent conversations as user-owned Markdown memory, searches conversations and source material through reme_search with BM25, optional embeddings, and wikilink expansion, and schedules daily memory consolidation.
description.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 接入 ReMe 本地优先、自进化的个人知识库：自动把已完成的主 Agent 对话沉淀为用户掌控的 Markdown 记忆，通过 reme_search 结合 BM25、可选向量检索和 wikilink 展开搜索对话与资料，并按日整理长期记忆。

description.en: DSH 桌面宠物：一行命令装好即用的透明动画小桌宠，支持多开、大小位置随心配置；还内置 DIY 素材链，能用 AI 视频自造专属宠物

description.zh: 前置要求：DeepSeek Harness 0.1.5-rc.1+（DSH Desktop ≥ 2.0.7）且 dsh-better-sidebar ≥ 0.19.0，安装或更新本插件前请先更新两者。把本机 Wallpaper Engine 的 Video/Web 壁纸实时播放到聊天界面后方，Scene 壁纸由内置渲染器输出完整场景帧，支持内容分级/类型过滤、自定义壁纸上传与 iOS 液态玻璃设置窗口。

Supports Amp Code, Antigravity CLI, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, DeepSeek Harness, Devin CLI, GitHub Copilot CLI, Grok Build, Hermes Agent, Kimi Code, OpenClaw, OpenCode, and Pi.

description.zh: 索引并搜索多个 AI 编程工具的会话历史，无需向量嵌入即可回溯过往工作。

description.en: Same-origin in mechanism with the two loudest lines in context compression. The code-skeleton gate follows the skeletonization approach of Headroom (Apache-2.0), whose published headline is 20% fewer tokens for coding agents and 60–95% fewer tokens for JSON, same answers. The estimator channel follows TokenPilot (arXiv:2606.17016), which reports up to 60% lower cost for long-session agents. Both figures are theirs, quoted as-is; this plugin ships no benchmark of its own and claims no reduction of its own. What it adds for DeepSeek Harness: choose a compression profile, set the Auto Compact trigger level and toggle code-skeleton compression from one settings section, with exact DeepSeek V4 tokenizer measurement, same-revision count verification, and fail-open behaviour that keeps the original tool results on unsupported models. Within a turn it supports skeletonized information compression with a low original-text retrieval rate; at the tail of a turn it supports a turn-tail intent summary implemented purely by content substitution; context content stays safe, and the whole process runs inside the official JSONL compression.
description.zh: 机制上与上下文压缩领域最响的两条公开路线同源：代码骨架闸门沿用 Headroom（Apache-2.0）的骨架化思路，其公开头条为「编程 agent 少 20% token、JSON 载荷少 60–95% token，答案不变」；估计器通道沿用 TokenPilot（arXiv:2606.17016）的缓存感知上下文管理思路，该论文报告长会话 agent 成本最高降低 60%。这两个数字都是来源方自己的口径，此处照引；本插件不自带 benchmark，不自称任何降幅。在此之上为 DeepSeek Harness 提供：在同一设置区选择压缩 Profile、调整 Auto Compact 触发水位并开关代码骨架压缩；基于 DeepSeek V4 官方 tokenizer 的精确计量与同修订计数校验；非支持模型自动 fail-open，保留原始工具结果。回合内支持骨架化信息压缩、低原文取回率；turn 尾部支持尾部意图摘要（turn-tail intent summary）且仅以内容替代方式实现；上下文内容安全，全程在官方 jsonl 压缩内。

description.en: Run one instruction on every online Windows and macOS machine, across networks and regions: a dependency-free relay talks to each machine over outbound connections only (Tailscale, a public VPS behind TLS, or a tunnel), every machine runs the command in its own checkout, and results come back with a commit, a working-tree fingerprint and a command hash so an environment mismatch is reported as unverifiable instead of being mistaken for a different result. Sending work needs its own operator token, separate from the per-machine device token.
description.zh: 一条指令同时下发给所有在线的 Windows 与 macOS 机器，可跨网络跨区域：零依赖中继只通过出站连接与各机通信（Tailscale 内网、公网 VPS + TLS、或隧道），各机在各自的项目副本上执行，结果连同 commit、工作区指纹与命令哈希一并回传，因此"环境不一致"会被判为 unverifiable，而不会被误当成结果分歧。下发指令需要独立于设备令牌的 operator token。

description.en: Rewind / retry / recall / fork orchestration (host) plus the browser half — replaces the conversation.chat.node user / steering rendering and overrides the conversation.composer.dock stats row.
Adds a generate_image tool backed by the FAL queue, any OpenAI-compatible images API, or a ChatGPT/Grok subscription, and shows the result inline in the conversation.
description.zh: 提供 generate_image 工具，可接入 FAL 队列、任意 OpenAI 兼容图像 API 或 ChatGPT/Grok 订阅，并在对话中内联显示结果。

description.en: Read-only Git and SVN change review inside DeepSeek Harness, with repository browsing and side-by-side diffs.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 内只读审阅 Git 与 SVN 变更，支持仓库浏览和并排差异对比。

description.en: dsh profile bundle: assembles @morlay/session-branch, @morlay/session-rdb, @morlay/ui-conversation-message-actions, @morlay/ui-conversation-manager and @morlay/dsh-reference into a DeepSeek Harness web profile — the rewind / retry / recall / fork closed l
Connects DeepSeek Harness to IM platforms like WeChat, DingTalk, QQ, and Feishu for seamless messaging.
description.zh: DSH IM Connect 基于 DeepSeek Harness 的IM链接插件，无缝链接微信、企业微信、钉钉、QQ、飞书等

description.en: Save every repetitive, tiresome templated prompt — one mouse click injects it into the composer and spares you the effort. 🌹
description.zh: 将一切重复、烦躁的模板化提示词保存下来，只需要鼠标点击就注入对话框，节省您的精力损耗🌹

description.en: Catppuccin themes plus a toggleable glassmorphism skin for the DSH Web GUI: Latte, Frappé, Macchiato and Mocha registered into the native theme runtime, one-click switching with a persisted choice, and adjustable frosted glass for the top bar, sidebar, composer, stats line and trajectory view.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 的 Catppuccin 主题插件：Latte、Frappé、Macchiato、Mocha 四套主题接入原生主题系统，一键切换并记住选择；另附可开关的玻璃质感皮肤，顶栏、侧边栏、输入框、统计行与轨迹视图的磨砂玻璃效果可自由调节。

description.en: Manages archived DSH chats with conversation search, restore, and confirmed safe permanent deletion.
description.zh: 管理 DSH 归档聊天，支持聊天记录搜索、恢复和二次确认的安全永久删除。

description.en: Voice input for the web UI: dictation chunked by pauses and voice messages, each with its own provider fallback chain (Deepgram, Groq, HuggingFace, local whisper.cpp, or an OpenAI-compatible endpoint).
description.zh: Web UI 语音输入：按停顿分段的听写与语音消息，各自拥有独立的服务商回退链（Deepgram、Groq、HuggingFace、本地 whisper.cpp 或 OpenAI 兼容接口）。

description.en: The memory that dreams — cross-session memory for DeepSeek Harness: recalls you and your projects across sessions, consolidates memories while idle (autoDream), freezes conflicting memories for your review, and keeps a replayable audit trail. Memory stays on your machine as SQLite with human-editable Markdown mirrors; four-way recall (keyword, vector, BM25, entity graph) and an interactive memory panel ship with it, plus 10 model tools, an MCP server, an external API and a CLI. Summarization and consolidation run on the host model you already configured; with a local embedder, semantic search runs fully offline.
description.zh: 会做梦的记忆 — DeepSeek Harness 跨会话记忆插件：跨会话记住你与项目，空闲时自动巩固记忆（autoDream），冲突记忆先冻结待你裁决，全程可回放审计。记忆落在本机：SQLite 存储配可人工编辑的 Markdown 镜像；附带四路召回（关键词、向量、BM25、实体图谱）与交互式记忆库面板，另有 10 个模型工具、MCP 服务端、外部 API 与 CLI。摘要与巩固走你已配置的宿主模型；把嵌入换成本地模型后，语义检索可完全离线运行。

description.en: Read-only runtime management panel for the official DSH MCP client: connection status, registered tools, errors, and reconnect counts through the /mcp command and a Settings tab, with sanitized display and enable/disable patch suggestions.
description.zh: 官方 MCP 客户端（dsh-mcp-client）的只读运行时管理面板：/mcp 命令与设置页 MCP 页签展示连接状态、已注册工具、错误与重连计数，脱敏展示并提供启停 patch 建议。

description.en: Use ChatGPT (Codex), Claude, and Grok subscriptions as DeepSeek Harness LLM providers, with Settings login, model catalogs, usage, plus image_generate, video_generate, and x_search tools.
description.zh: 把 ChatGPT（Codex）、Claude、Grok 订阅当作 DeepSeek Harness 的 LLM 提供方：设置页登录、模型目录、用量展示，以及 image_generate、video_generate 与 x_search 工具。

description.en: Keeps a pool of API keys per provider with auto-created clone routes, switches to the next key on quota or rate-limit errors, probes cooled keys for recovery, and exposes the pools, cooldown and switch codes in a Settings section.
description.zh: 为每个提供方维护 API Key 池并自动创建克隆路由，在配额或限流错误时切换到下一个 Key，主动探测冷却中的 Key 以便恢复，并在设置中提供 Key 池、冷却时间与切换状态码的编辑界面。

description.en: Engineering intelligence for coding agents — persistent, evidence-aware, project-isolated engineering memory with unified hybrid search (memory + RAG documentation) for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 面向编程代理的工程智能——为 DeepSeek Harness 提供持久化、证据感知、项目隔离的工程记忆，以及统一的混合搜索（记忆 + RAG 文档）。

description.en: Create, edit, inspect, and deliver spreadsheets, documents, presentations, databases, and canvases in DeepSeek Harness, with live preview and worktree review.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中创建、编辑、检查和交付表格、文档、演示文稿、多维表格和画布，支持实时预览与 worktree 审阅。

description.en: ClineBot and ClinePass integration for DeepSeek Harness: dedicated settings page, live quota dashboard, in-UI key saving, curated and custom model selection, and a /cline command.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 ClineBot/ClinePass 集成：专属设置页、实时配额仪表板、界面内密钥保存、精选与自定义模型选择，以及 /cline 命令。

description.en: Task ledger board for dsh (DeepSeek Harness): read-only board over task-ledger skill workspaces. The task-ledger skill is bundled — install the plugin, get the skill globally.

Per-model appearance for the DSH Web UI: an ordered rule list matched against the current session model name, each rule carrying its own wallpaper, theme colour, layout mode, framing and wallpaper opacity and blur, plus per-surface opacity and frosted-glass blur for the main background, left panel, right panel, cards and panels, input and controls, settings panel, conversation text frame and trajectory view.
description.zh: 按模型切换 DSH Web 界面外观：有序规则列表按当前会话的模型名匹配，每条规则自带壁纸、主题色、布局模式、取景与背景透明度、模糊；另有主背景、左侧栏、右侧栏、卡片面板、输入框与控件、设置面板、对话文本框、轨迹页的分区透明度与毛玻璃模糊。

description.en: Connect locally signed-in WorkBuddy models to DeepSeek Harness with a read-only credits overview and model management.
description.zh: 接入本地 WorkBuddy 模型，提供只读积分概览与模型管理。

description.en: AgentOne 平台集成：平台模型、SkillHub 技能、套餐、CLI、飞书云盘共享文件夹（web/官方桌面端侧栏页签 + 左栏底部入口；「启用云盘」后 AI 可读取/搜索资料、看最近更新、存文档、传本地文件）、左栏「工作台」面板（卡片集中打开内嵌应用：DOC数字化AI运营平台，网页内嵌或 applink 唤起飞书客户端，切面板不断页）
Enables AI agents to control a real, logged-in browser via CLI and extension, automating tasks without disruption.
description.zh: 通过 CLI 与扩展让智能体操控真实登录的浏览器，无干扰地自动化任务。

description.en: ACP profile plugin and standalone stdio server for using the full DSH agent from Zed and other ACP clients while sharing DSH credentials and sessions.
description.zh: ACP profile 插件与独立 stdio server，可从 Zed 等 ACP 客户端使用完整 DSH agent，并共享 DSH 凭据与会话。

description.en: Provides a Codex-style interface for interacting with DeepSeek Harness, enhancing the user experience.
description.zh: 用Codex的方式打开deepseek-harness

description.en: Port all 38 opencode themes into DeepSeek Harness, light and dark alike: quiet Tokyo Night, soft Catppuccin, easy on the eyes Zenburn. Plus 25 IP theme capsules: Genshin, Kuromi, Doraemon, Hello Kitty, Harry Potter, Cyberpunk 2077, Dragon Ball, Naruto, One Piece, Pokémon, Sailor Moon, Star Wars, Transformers, Ultraman, Zelda, Super Mario, Evangelion, LEGO, Marvel, DC, Disney, four of them in a second light/dark take, each with its own soul. And every theme is fully editable, so you can craft one that is entirely your own.
description.zh: 将opencode的38款主题搬进DSH，明暗兼收：东京之夜沉静、卡布奇诺轻柔、禅燃护眼；另备25款主题胶囊，原神、原神·夜航、库洛米、哆啦A梦、HelloKitty、哈利波特、赛博朋克2077、龙珠、火影忍者、火影忍者·暗部、海贼王、宝可梦、美少女战士、星球大战、变形金刚、奥特曼、塞尔达传说、超级马里奥、超级马里奥·夜行、新世纪福音战士、新世纪福音战士·晴空、乐高、漫威、DC、迪士尼，各有其魂；每款主题都可逐色细改，打造属于您的专属主题。

description.en: Scheduled cron tasks, background automation and agent execution for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供定时任务、后台自动化与 Agent 执行。

description.en: Sidebar session search that builds its own index instead of reusing DSH's full-text one: title to content toggle in one entry, results grouped per session with the strongest snippet and user/reply/tool tags, plus watermark-based incremental sync, archive-driven pruning of archived sessions, and a shadow rebuild that never blocks the live index.
description.zh: 自带独立索引的侧边栏会话搜索（不再复用 DSH 官方全文索引）：一处入口在标题与内容检索间切换，结果按会话聚合，附最强命中片段与 用户/回复/工具 类型标签；水位驱动增量同步、按归档集合清理已归档会话，整理走影子索引不阻塞在用索引。

description.en: Recent conversations stay vivid. Older ones fade into summaries, not oblivion. StrataGate gives DeepSeek Harness six-layer, time-decaying memory, while lasting events and relationships settle into a knowledge graph. Bring your memories from other AIs with you—no need to start over.
description.zh: 近期对话保持清晰，久远记忆逐渐化为摘要，而不是消失。StrataGate 为 DeepSeek Harness 带来六层时间衰减记忆，并将长期事件与关系沉淀进知识图谱。还可以把其他 AI 中的已有记忆一起带过来，不必从头开始。

description.en: The DSH plugin-development knowledge base as an on-demand agent skill: official constraints, task workflows, API reference and community gotchas, installed with the bundle so the agent can look things up while building a plugin.
description.zh: DSH 插件开发知识库，作为按需加载的 agent 技能随 bundle 安装：官方约束、任务工作流、API 参考与社区踩坑，写插件时让 DSH 自己查。

description.en: Microi吾码 AI 开发 CLI 与多宿主 Plugin：服务器连接、Skills、MCP、V8 同步和低代码交付
DeepSeek Harness 插件：在对话中搜索、安装和管理 SkillHub 技能
Provides lightweight context management to keep essential memory active without heavy overhead.
description.zh: 提供轻量级上下文管理，保持关键记忆活跃且不增加过多负担。

description.en: Custom modes / assistant manager: give each mode its own system prompt in the settings page — a custom prompt that is a plain file the agent loop re-reads before every model step, so an edit applies to the running session on its next step — and start it from the official standard / PTC / minimal / Cordis composition, toggling the plugin rows it mounts one by one (a custom plugin composition per mode), renaming it as you like. Several assistants coexist with their own prompts, so one machine can keep a coding assistant, a chat companion and a roleplay (RP) persona side by side — a multi-agent setup you pick from per new session. Rows left untouched stay byte-identical to the shipped ones, platform conditions included.
description.zh: 自定义模式管理器 / 多助手管理器：在设置页里给每个模式写一份自己的系统提示词——自定义提示词就是普通文件，agent loop 每次模型调用前重新读取，改完对正在运行的会话下一步即生效；模式以官方 standard / PTC / 极简 / Cordis 的组成为底子，可逐行开关它挂载哪些插件，等于每个模式一份自定义插件组合，也能改模式名。多个助手可并存、各有各的提示词，所以一台机器上可以同时留一个编码助手、一个聊天搭子、一个角色扮演（RP）人格，新建会话时挑一个。没碰过的行与出厂行逐字节相同（含平台条件）。

description.en: Hierarchical Claude Code-style memory: user + project scopes (project memories committed to git for the team), MEMORY.md index auto-injected at session start, context-window guards, pure files.
description.zh: 分层 Claude Code 式记忆：用户级+项目级双作用域（项目记忆随 git 团队共享），MEMORY.md 索引会话启动自动注入，上下文护栏，纯文件零依赖。

description.en: dsh Web UI admin plugin: eleven management panels (extensions, skills, MCP servers, subagents, commands, hooks, automation - cron / webhook / workflow, sessions & web search, usage dashboard, todo dock) inside the official dsh settings UI

Three-tier now/next/later input planning dock for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: a red/yellow/green priority strip replaces the busy-Enter queue, plain Enter queues to later, with in-place multi-line editing, drag reorder, and session-isolated freeze/resume; the freeze button bridges a separate plugin, [dsh-session-guard](https://github.com/drscrewdriver/dsh-session-guard) (installable from dsh-market), via stopNextTurn/resume RPC + composer lock for a real per-session lock, pairing with its global peak-hour auto-pause to stop sessions during DeepSeek's high-cost windows and resume off-peak.
description.zh: 三档（now/next/later）输入规划 dock：以红/黄/绿色优先级条取代忙碌 Enter 排队栏，普通 Enter 排入 later，支持多行原位编辑、拖拽排序与会话级冻结/恢复；冻结按钮经 stopNextTurn/resume RPC + 输入框锁定，桥接另一独立插件 [dsh-session-guard](https://github.com/drscrewdriver/dsh-session-guard)（可在 dsh-market 安装）实现按会话真实冻结锁定，并配合其高峰全局自动暂停，在 DeepSeek 高价时段停止会话、错峰自动恢复。

description.en: Upgrades DSH image viewing with pointer-centered zoom, pan, galleries, downloads, keyboard support, and inline region notes.
description.zh: 增强 DSH 原生图片查看体验，支持指针中心缩放、拖动、画廊、下载、键盘操作和图片区域备注。

description.en: Query the dshbase plugin directory from inside DeepSeek Harness — search, list, and get install commands for 1700+ plugins.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里直接搜索、浏览 dshbase 插件库，获取 1100+ 社区插件的安装命令，不用离开会话。

description.en: Session Steward for DSH: browse and bulk-prune the official session archive set, and run a four-gate health checkup (log integrity, projection cache, lossless JSON, cold read) that ends in a reversible, backup-first prescription. Never rewrites session logs.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的会话管家：浏览并批量清理官方会话归档集合，并对会话做四门体检（日志完整性 / 投影缓存 / 无损 JSON / 冷读），最终给出可逆、先备份的处方。不改写会话日志。

description.en: Provides a plugin marketplace within DSH to search, download, and install community plugins.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 社区内置插件市场（dsh-plugin）— 搜索插件、下载并安装 4000+ 人工精选社区插件，每日更新、完全免费。内置在 Harness「设置 → 插件中心」，无需离开应用即可浏览、搜索、安装各类 AI 插件。

description.en: Configure reasoning-effort levels and sub-agent defaults for custom DSH models.
description.zh: 为 DSH 自定义模型配置思考档位和子 agent 默认思考强度。

description.en: Fish DSH 插件聚合包：十个本仓库子包与独立 AgentTeams，共十一个 @fish-under-sea 成员，成员精确固定各自版本；破甲不内置，需单独安装。

Configurable send and newline keys, a composer context menu with three sources (leave it to DSH and other plugins / browser menu / plugin-styled custom menu), a quick-command panel with categorized prompt lists where each prompt can append on every send or only on the first message of a session, a create-and-move row at the bottom of each category, a prompt optimizer that rewrites the draft with a separate model call, settings-panel size memory, and automatic x-opencode-session header injection for OpenCode routes. Prompt lists live in a global ~/.dsh/quick-prompts.json that is independent of the session and the project.
description.zh: 可配置发送/换行键位、输入框右键菜单三种来源（插件不介入 / 浏览器菜单 / 自定义样式菜单）、带分类的快捷指令面板（每条可设「每次发送都附加」或「仅在本会话第一条消息附加」，并有跨分类移动与新建）、用另一次模型调用把草稿整理成清晰指令的提示词优化、设置面板尺寸记忆，并为 OpenCode 路由自动注入 x-opencode-session 请求头。快捷指令存在全局文件 ~/.dsh/quick-prompts.json 里，与会话、项目无关。

description.en: A governed registry for MCP connectors (stdio and streamable-http): four-level fail-closed authorization, mcpServers JSON import that rejects malformed args, credential redaction at every output boundary, an agent bridge that returns an honest review verdict instead of a fake approval, and a /mcp-reg operator console plus a settings page.
description.zh: MCP 连接器（stdio / streamable-http）的受治理注册表：四级 fail-closed 授权、mcpServers JSON 导入对畸形 args 大声报错、输出边界全程脱敏、agent 桥接返回诚实 review 而非伪装放行，配 /mcp-reg 操作台与设置页。

description.en: Shows a card in the sidebar footer with the DeepSeek account balance (read from the official /user/balance endpoint with the API key DSH already stores) and the unit prices of the active model — input, cache read and output — taken from a built-in snapshot of the official price table. A dot marks the current billing window and a countdown shows the time left until it flips: peak is Mon–Fri 9:00–12:00 and 14:00–18:00 Beijing Time, excluding Chinese public holidays, and everything else is off-peak. Prices and the dot appear only for official DeepSeek models; for any other model the card shows the balance alone. The card refreshes every 30 seconds, on click, and when the model changes, and follows the app theme and the DSH language.
description.zh: 在侧边栏底部显示一张卡片：DeepSeek 账号余额（用 DSH 已保存的 API Key 调官方 /user/balance 接口获取），以及当前模型的档单价——输入、缓存读取、输出——取自内置的官方价格表快照。一个圆点标出当前计费时段，旁边是距离切换的倒计时：高峰为北京时间周一至周五 9:00–12:00、14:00–18:00（不含中国法定节假日），其余为空闲时段。档单价与圆点只对 DeepSeek 官方模型显示，其他模型只显示余额。卡片每 30 秒刷新一次，点击或切换模型时立即刷新，并跟随应用主题与 DSH 语言。

description.en: One-command skinning for DSH Web: 8 original themes, wallpaper (opacity/blur/gradient/URL), per-user accent, shareable theme packs, favorites and surprise-me. Purely native token system.
description.zh: DSH Web 一键换肤插件：8 套原创主题、背景壁纸（透明度/模糊/渐变/URL）、每用户强调色、主题包导入导出与分享链接、收藏与随机，纯原生 token 系统。

description.en: OpenCode Go provider for DeepSeek Harness: live gateway catalog, per-conversation session header, usage

Chat-operated multi-database admin plugin for DeepSeek Harness: query and manage MySQL, PostgreSQL, GaussDB, MongoDB, Redis, Oracle, DM and SQLite from the conversation with project-scoped ro/rw grants, a sidebar management panel, schema browsing and data preview, and confirmation-gated dangerous operations.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 社区插件：在对话中直接管理多数据库（MySQL、PostgreSQL、GaussDB、MongoDB、Redis、Oracle、达梦、SQLite），支持项目级 ro/rw 授权、侧边栏管理面板、结构浏览与数据预览，危险操作需确认后执行。
